card.name: Sentence-initial G in instructions
card.fires_on: The letter G starting a sentence or step, mostly the start of 'Gently' in handling instructions (swirl, tap, push, stir) after syringe or mixing steps. Also starts of other G words like Gastrointestinal or Glands.
